channel.title: Humanoids Daily
channel.description: We bring you the latest developments in robotics, with a special focus on humanoid robots and intelligent machines. From groundbreaking research to real-world applications, we cover the people, technologies, and innovations shaping the future of robotics.

item.title: Figure’s Multibillion-Dollar Compute Deal Meets Nscale’s Data-Center Buildout Challenge
item.description: New reporting highlights the financing and construction behind Nscale’s expansion, adding context to Figure’s future GPU capacity without establishing a delay to its deal.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Boston Dynamics Makes Its Case for Atlas and a Two-Year Payback Target
item.description: A new short film argues that experience with Spot and Stretch, plus Hyundai’s factories and supply chain, gives Boston Dynamics an edge in commercializing Atlas.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: NEURA Launches HealthTech Unit, With MiPA on Its Healthcare Roadmap
item.description: NEURA’s dedicated healthcare unit starts with autonomous empty-bed transport, while its wheeled MiPA robot trains for patient-room assistance and medication support.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: IDC Puts H1 Humanoid Shipments Near 25,000, With AGIBOT Leading
item.description: IDC estimates nearly 25,000 humanoid shipments in H1 2026, with AGIBOT citing a 35% share. The new tally differs from earlier estimates for the same period.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: MindOn Targets Human Speed in New Mind-1 Robot Demo
item.description: MindOn’s latest demo shows parcel handling, shirt folding and laundry collection at what it labels real-time speed, following last year’s viral household-chore video.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Matic Teases a Humanoid as It Looks Beyond Floor Cleaning
item.description: Matic previews a cap-wearing humanoid and says manipulation comes next, with an earlier Sunday design comparison adding a backstory to the teaser.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Boston Dynamics Takes a Drone Through Atlas Production in New Hiring Push
item.description: A new fly-through shows the workshops and assembly spaces behind Atlas, as Boston Dynamics promotes ProtoOps hiring and lists roles across manufacturing, testing and data operations.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AGIBOT Says 100 X2 Humanoids Are Working Across 100 ASD Retail Stores
item.description: The cookware retailer is using X2 robots for greetings and product recommendations, while human staff handle transactions. A three-day livestream offers a look at selected stores.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Chestnut Launches Aero Hand and Aero UMI, Pairing Dexterous Hardware With Its Data Collector
item.description: The IROS 2026 launch pairs an 18-DOF robotic hand with a wearable capture and teleoperation rig, aiming to reduce the gap between human demonstrations and robot execution.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Dyna Reveals Taku Robot and Dyna-2.1 With an Hour-Long Autonomous Laundry Demo
item.description: Dyna’s new wheeled semi-humanoid combines manipulation, whole-body control and workflow reasoning. Customer-site deployment is the next step after its uncut laundry demonstration.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: T-Robotics to Lead KRW 4.5 Billion Humanoid Project for Korean Display Factories
item.description: The project pairs T-Robotics with KAIST and a major display manufacturer for development and production-line trials through 2030, adding an industrial application to South Korea’s humanoid push.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AMD Agrees to Buy World Labs for $8.2 Billion, Bringing Spatial AI In-House
item.description: Fei-Fei Li will become AMD’s chief scientist under an acquisition agreement that brings world models and robotics simulation research closer to the chipmaker’s hardware roadmap.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Hasta La Vista, Figure 02: Adcock Teases a Terminator-Style Sendoff
item.description: An AI-generated teaser points to September 30 after Arnold Schwarzenegger suggested melting Figure’s retired robots—overruling, perhaps, a poll that favored blowing them up.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Delta Intelligence Targets Energy and Infrastructure Beyond Its Household Robot Demo
item.description: In answers to Humanoids Daily, Delta founder Xiaojian Ma outlines a cross-brand head-and-backpack system, whole-body data collection and a commercial focus on harsh industrial environments.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Dyna Robotics Teases a New Robot Built for Real Work
item.description: Dyna promises a first look at a new robot, following its Dyna-2 model release and reported customer expansion. Specifications and a launch date remain undisclosed.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Figure Joins NVIDIA’s Open Agent Safety Platform as Humanoid Deployment Approaches
item.description: Figure backs NVIDIA’s agent-safety initiative, while Gecko’s CEO outlines inspection robots working within human-set limits. How the platform will be integrated into Figure’s robots remains undisclosed.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Sharpa Launches D01 Robot, W02 Hand and AE01 Haptic Glove at IROS 2026
item.description: Sharpa expands its manipulation hardware lineup with a tactile-sensing robot, a sub-750-gram dexterous hand and an exoskeleton glove for teleoperation and training data.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Niantic Spatial Launches Places Library With 100 Real Environments for Robot Training
item.description: Niantic Spatial pairs captured 3D scenes with collision geometry for robot simulation, offering free samples, paid access, and a relighting beta.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: HD Hyundai Wants Humanoid AI to Upgrade Its Existing Factory Robots
item.description: HD Hyundai Robotics plans to bring humanoid perception and manipulation technology to existing factory robots, alongside hand development with AIDIN and its Persona AI welding partnership.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla Reportedly Builds Hundreds of Optimus Robots a Week
item.description: The Information reports a roughly tenfold Optimus production increase, but says current V3 units are not the final customer version and details hardware, supplier and AI challenges.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Asimov Open-Sources the Training Code Behind Its Humanoid’s Walk
item.description: The Asimov 1 release exposes locomotion rewards, actuator settings and simulation training code, giving developers tools to adapt the walking controller for the open-source humanoid.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AGIBOT Has Built 20,000 Robots—Twice Its March Total
item.description: AGIBOT says cumulative robot production has reached 20,000, with its latest milestone machine delivered to Chimelong. Recent checkpoints suggest roughly 5,000 additional units per quarter across a mixed fleet.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Analysts See a PEEK Boom in Humanoid Robots. Kingfa’s Robotics Lead Says Most of It Is Hype
item.description: Barclays says one million humanoids by 2030 could mean 10,000 tons of PEEK demand. Kingfa’s robotics technical lead questions most current applications, highlighting the gap between today’s designs and future forecasts.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: O-ID Raises $1.2M to Build Humanoids With Swappable Parts
item.description: The Tokyo startup is designing modular industrial robots for on-site repairs in minutes, with Japanese automotive manufacturing and logistics as its first targets.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Feather launches a $30,000 wheeled humanoid for developers, announces $7.6M funding
item.description: The startup is betting on simple hardware and an open platform that lets customers choose their own AI.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AGIBOT Brings 300-Plus Robots to Chimelong Theme Park
item.description: AGIBOT and Chimelong have launched a robot deployment spanning performances, visitor guidance and hotel services at the existing Spaceship Park in Zhuhai, alongside a joint tourism research institute.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Skild AI’s S1 Learns Soccer Through More Than 140 Years of Simulated Self-Play
item.description: Skild reports real-world soccer play after more than 140 years of simulated self-play. Its published account details human-referenced drills before the goal-driven self-play stage.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: XPENG Lines Up Humanoid Suppliers Ahead of Year-End Production Target
item.description: XPENG says it has signed supplier agreements and is scheduling robot production after its first partner conference, as humanoid developers confront the challenge of securing consistent components at scale.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Vesoma Emerges From Stealth With a Humanoid Built to Learn
item.description: The European team behind the Kyle prototype reveals Vesoma, led by Synapticon and Easybrain co-founders, with former DeepMind research director Martin Riedmiller heading AI and its first Vesoma 1 units under construction.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla App Contains Optimus Gen 3 Renders—Here’s What They Show
item.description: Optimus renders labeled gen3 first appeared in Tesla’s Android app on August 27, a four-build comparison shows. Higher-resolution versions arrived September 5, but the assets do not confirm final hardware or a working robot interface.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)
